{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Step 1: Filter for completed orders
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Step 2: Clean revenue — remove commas and convert to float
# Check if any revenue values have commas (thousands separators)
print("Sample of revenue strings:")
print(completed_data['revenue'].head(10))

# Replace commas and convert to float
completed_data['revenue_clean'] = completed_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Step 3: Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed_data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Remove QA orders
clean_completed = completed_data[~qa_mask]

# Step 4: Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = clean_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after cleaning and removing QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
